snippet.title: Tarvos Desolation - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
🕹️ Play the free demo now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4069980/Tarvos_Desolation_Demo

Tarvos Desolation is a single-player sci-fi horror shooter game set on a hostile alien moon.

After a catastrophic crash, you awaken as the sole survivor of a failed mission.

Explore abandoned facilities, uncover lost crew logs, and face swarms of grotesque alien creatures lurking in the darkness. Every encounter pushes your skills — and sanity — to the limit.

#TarvosDesolation #steamnextfest #horrorgame
